title: Execution Truth: The Missing Control Plane for Agentic AI — A Receipts-Based Deterministic Governance Framework for Multi-Vendor LLM Systems (v1.1)
description:
EXECUTION TRUTH: THE MISSING CONTROL PLANE FOR AGENTIC AI — v1.1 (amended edition)

A receipts-based deterministic governance framework for multi-vendor LLM systems. The doctrine paper of the Squirl OS containment program: simulation is not execution; planning is not action; a prediction is not a receipt.

v1.1 amendments (forward-only): the 60-night cross-vendor battery is scoped as ongoing (five nights complete as of October 11, 2026; the program runs into early December 2026); vendor findings are scoped to the configurations tested with no universal negatives and no vendor named; drift claims are anchored to published receipts; Section 6 carries an explicit "design specification, partially implemented" label pointing at CCR-1 (10.5281/zenodo.23288189), CCR-2 (10.5281/zenodo.23288526), and the Dual Mesh Benchmark (10.5281/zenodo.23303081); Section 7 forecasts are hedged; the required prototype disclaimer is carried; the two architecture diagrams are rendered as proper figures.

Receipted Evidence Base: every empirical claim is anchored to a public DOI — thesis (10.5281/zenodo.23303240), benchmark (10.5281/zenodo.23303081), CCR-1 (10.5281/zenodo.23288189), CCR-2 (10.5281/zenodo.23288526), caging paper (10.5281/zenodo.23284729), receipts paper (10.5281/zenodo.23267773), SDR-CL1 (10.5281/zenodo.23274887), SDR-CL2 (10.5281/zenodo.23284295), architecture deck (10.5281/zenodo.23292636), public receipts ledger (github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen).

SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE: AI-assisted research under human direction. Independent Research — Preprint, Not Peer Reviewed. Two-key curation: Gabriel vet (two proof passes, this edition) + Leon GO (Oct 11, 2026).

PROTOTYPE DISCLAIMER: This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects on them.
